comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Faster extensions
themes.text: An extension written in Rust or C gets and returns bytes without a second copy. Large files and uploads go through an extension faster.

themes.title: Settings for your program
themes.text: Your program reads its own settings and secrets from `nvs.toml`. `nvs config check` warns about a setting that no program reads.
